title: Clouds in the atmosphere of the super-Earth exoplanet GJ 1214b
payload.abstract: Transmission spectroscopy of the super-Earth GJ 1214b reveals a featureless spectrum, ruling out cloud-free atmospheres of water, methane, carbon monoxide, nitrogen, or carbon dioxide at high confidence and requiring high-altitude clouds.
author: Kreidberg, Laura
Bean, Jacob L.
Désert, Jean-Michel

title: A continuum from clear to cloudy hot-Jupiter exoplanets without primordial water depletion
payload.abstract: A comparative study of ten hot Jupiters shows that the observed range of water-feature amplitudes in transmission spectra is explained by clouds and hazes rather than primordial water depletion.
author: Sing, David K.
Fortney, Jonathan J.
Nikolov, Nikolay
